name: צֹעַן
summary: Zoan is the Egyptian city in whose field Yahweh did his wonders, built seven years after Hebron. The name is the Egyptian Ḏꜥn.t, Tanis.

evidence.note: Yahweh did wonders in the field of Zoan.
Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.

evidence.locator: Ancient Egyptian Dictionary, place name Ḏꜥn.t, TLA 853903
evidence.note: Egyptian Ḏꜥn.t, Tanis: the place name borrowed into Hebrew.

note: Moved from the former word entry `9o3an` (old root key צענ); its Egyptian loan cognate egy-tanis (Ḏꜥn.t, “Tanis”) is now a source citation in evidence. The similar Hebrew verb for moving camp in Isaiah 33:20 does not explain the city name.
